subject: kraken
pitch:
Category: Monster.
Subject: kraken rising, tentacles spread.
Style: Overwatch.
reasoning:
I'm planning a kraken model in an Overwatch-style look—bold, cel-shaded, clean silhouette—built with a moderate set of parts using the builder's joint, chain, sweep, and sprout-type functions to keep the structure manageable and functional.

I'm thinking through the pose: the kraken rising from water with its mantle base near ground level and tentacles curling outward and upward, scaling the mantle to roughly 1.2–1.6m tall with a teardrop-shaped body tapering toward the top, plus a spine chain forming the core structure and sphere-based eyes mounted on the mantle sides.

For the rest I'm planning triangular fins extruded on the mantle flanks, eight tentacles radiating from a ring at the base and each curving outward with tapering sweeps and small sucker discs placed along them, all parented to the core joint, finished with a bold saturated teal-blue countershaded paint style in a flat, rim-lit Overwatch aesthetic.

Now I'm working out the color palette: teal-navy countershading for the body, a purple-to-pink gradient along the tentacle sweeps for lighter tips, and SVG decal textures for the eyes with a yellow-orange iris and dark slit pupil placed directly on the mantle surface. I'm also planning for the tentacles to rise upward with curled tips as if reaching through water.

Setting up imports and sweep paths...

Still tuning the bell curve formula...

Defining the mantle sweep points so the top sits around 1.6 units high, then placing eyes on the mantle surface using an azimuth-based surface query near the sides.

I'm designing the eye decal with a dark outer ring, bright yellow iris, vertical slit pupil, and a white highlight for a bold Overwatch-style look, then moving on to sketch the side fins on the mantle.

Still working out fin placement...

Now I'm plotting eight tentacles radiating around the base, each as a curved path from a root point near the mantle bottom, sweeping outward and upward with some randomness, curling at the tip for a natural tapering look.

Still writing tentacle geometry...

Using a small disc geometry oriented by the sweep's normal to place each sucker with slight embedding, capped at around five per tentacle to keep part count manageable. I'll skip adding tentacle tip clubs for simplicity and move on to figuring out the mantle's countershaded coloring.

Now I'm settling on a mottled teal-to-deep color blend for the mantle with subtle countershading, and planning to add a small beak spike positioned at the center base of the tentacles, angled downward beneath the mantle.

Setting up the joint core and mantle chain structure, then sweeping the bell shape over it with the body color. I'm placing eyes on the mantle surface using azimuth and elevation coordinates, with front facing +Z and eyes offset to the sides.

Confirming the fin position relative to mantle radius, then moving on to build the eye SVG with a dark outer ring, yellow iris, and pupil detailing.

Finishing up the suckers, mantle countershading with stripe patterns, and setting up the final export structure with builder metadata and root return.

Still shaping the tentacle path...
